tools.name: help
tools.title: Spaces and skills
tools.description: Start here. Lists the spaces you can use and the skills available (pages that say when to read them); with `space`, also an outline of that space. With `topic`, returns that skill or page. `space` defaults to your only space when you have one; without a space, `topic` finds built-in skills only.

topic.description: Skill or page name; a close match is enough.

space.description: Space name or id, as listed by `help`.

tools.name: read
tools.title: Read a page
tools.description: Read a page's Markdown and revision. `offset`/`limit` read a numbered slice; `outline` maps a long page first; `rendered` shows it as displayed, with lint problems (needs the runtime); `pages` reads several; a name ending in "/" lists the pages under it. Output is capped.

space.description: Space name or id, as listed by `help`.

page.description: Page name, e.g. "Projects/Garden Plan". The .md extension is optional, except for a name ending in a dot and letters or digits ("Notes v1.2"), which otherwise names a document.

rendered.description: Evaluate the page as it displays, and list lint problems.

outline.description: Headings, code blocks and Lua functions with line numbers, instead of the text.

tools.name: write
tools.title: Write a page
tools.description: Create a page or replace it entirely with the given content. To change part of an existing page use `edit` instead.

space.description: Space name or id, as listed by `help`.

page.description: Page name, e.g. "Projects/Garden Plan". The .md extension is optional, except for a name ending in a dot and letters or digits ("Notes v1.2"), which otherwise names a document.

content.description: Full Markdown content of the page.

ifRevision.description: Revision from a previous read; the call fails instead of overwriting a newer change.

tools.name: edit
tools.title: Edit a page
tools.description: Replace exact text in a page. Each edit's oldText must match exactly once in the page as read (line endings are normalised), and edits must not overlap; all apply or none does. With dryRun the unified diff is returned and nothing is written.

space.description: Space name or id, as listed by `help`.

page.description: Page name, e.g. "Projects/Garden Plan". The .md extension is optional, except for a name ending in a dot and letters or digits ("Notes v1.2"), which otherwise names a document.

ifRevision.description: Revision from a previous read; the call fails instead of overwriting a newer change.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search pages
tools.description: Full-text search over a space's pages. Modes: "words" (default; all words, any order), "phrase" (exact phrase) and "semantic" (by meaning, where the space has it). Returns matching passages with their page, line and heading.

space.description: Space name or id, as listed by `help`.

tools.name: lua
tools.title: Run Space Lua
tools.description: Run Space Lua in the space's runtime and return the JSON result. An expression (`1 + 1`, a `query[[...]]`) returns its value; statements run as a script (use `return` for a value). Console output from the call is appended. Calls can change the space; keep queries narrow and add a limit.

space.description: Space name or id, as listed by `help`.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot the editor
tools.description: Take a PNG screenshot of the space's editor in its runtime. With `page`, navigate there first. `selector` (CSS) captures one element; `fullPage` stitches the whole page and cannot be combined with `selector`.

space.description: Space name or id, as listed by `help`.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole page, not just the viewport.
